quests.title: Find three trees changing color
quests.hint: Look for yellow or red edges on broad leaves.

quests.title: Spot a moss-covered rock
quests.hint: Check the shaded side of large boulders near water.

quests.title: Hear two different bird calls
quests.hint: Stand still for thirty seconds near a clearing.

quests.title: Find a wildflower still blooming
quests.hint: Late-season flowers hide near sun-warmed walls and south-facing slopes.

quests.title: Spot a mushroom on a fallen log
quests.hint: Damp rotting wood under tree cover is the best place to look.

quests.title: Find a spider web with dew on it
quests.hint: Early morning is best. Check between low branches or fence posts.
